title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**

Own test automation strategy and execution across the organization's platform — including AI\-powered features, Salesforce workflows, and ERP integrations — ensuring releases are reliable and regressions are caught before production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build automated test suites (UI, API, integration) for platform, Salesforce, and AI features
* Design and run beta and A/B test programs to validate feature quality and rollout risk before general release
* Set up and maintain CI/CD\-integrated test pipelines, introducing new testing approaches (contract testing, canary/progressive rollout gating, synthetic monitoring) as the pipeline matures
* Build and maintain Python\-driven unit and integration test frameworks across services
* Define QA processes, test plans, and coverage strategy with engineering
* Perform manual exploratory testing where automation isn't yet in place
* Design test/eval sets for AI features (prompt/response validation, regression on model outputs)
* Track and report defects, working with engineers to resolution
* Continuously improve test reliability and reduce flaky tests

**Tech Stack**

* Automation frameworks: Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium
* Python testing frameworks: pytest, unittest (unit \+ integration test authoring, mandatory)
* API testing: Postman/Newman, REST\-assured
* CI/CD: GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, with feature\-flag/A\-B\-testing tooling (LaunchDarkly or Azure App Configuration feature flags)
* Scripting: Python (primary), JavaScript/TypeScript
* Salesforce testing: Provar or equivalent (nice to have)
* AI eval tooling exposure: PromptFoo or custom eval scripts

**Cutting\-Edge AI Skills**

* Designing test cases and eval sets for LLM\-powered features (accuracy, hallucination, safety checks)
* Basic prompt/response comparison and regression testing for AI outputs
* Understanding of non\-deterministic system testing strategies

**Business Domain Exposure**

* The organization is a large\-scale master real estate developer delivering mixed\-use residential, commercial, and hospitality communities across multiple master\-planned developments, alongside affiliated retail, wellness/fitness, food \& beverage, hospitality, education, and property\-management operating brands.
* Testing sales/CRM workflows (Salesforce) tied to real\-estate booking and payment processes
* Validating AI\-assisted features used by sales and buyer\-facing teams
* Regression testing across ERP\-integrated finance/procurement workflows

**Must\-Have Requirements**

* Mandatory: hands\-on beta testing and A/B testing experience (test design, rollout gating, results analysis)
* Mandatory: experience introducing new testing approaches within a CI/CD pipeline (beyond basic pipeline test\-running)
* Mandatory: Python\-driven unit and integration testing framework experience (pytest/unittest)
* Hands\-on experience with automation frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar)
* API testing experience (Postman, REST\-assured, or similar)
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Strong understanding of QA methodology and defect lifecycle

**Nice to Have**

* Performance/load testing experience
* Experience testing AI\-powered features (prompt/response validation)
* ISTQB or equivalent QA certification

Pay: ₹85,000\.00 \- ₹200,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* QA/test automation: 7 years (Preferred)
* beta/A/B testing : 7 years (Preferred)
* Python\-driven unit \& integration test frameworks: 7 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
